title: Shape Layer vs Effect Parade stream topology
question: Does the public AEGP stream topology expose genuinely different ownership/Indexed Group semantics for Shape Layer Contents and effect parameters?

hypotheses.prediction: Native Contents has indexed children and concrete vector match-names absent from an effect parameter topic tree.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Both surfaces exhibit identical group creation contracts including plug-in-defined arbitrary child types.

hypotheses.prediction: An effect's parameter topic does not expose a general new native Contents-type registration operation.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Reproducible supported AEGP registration produces a plug-in-owned new Indexed Group type.

factors: native shape layer with empty and populated Contents
normal footage/solid layer with a third-party effect
nested group and vector operator count
procedure: Build ShapeLayerAE read-only AEGP inspector against SDK 25.6.
In a disposable project create a shape layer, native rectangle/path/fill/repeater, and a conventional effect.
Select each layer and run Animation > ShapeLayerAE: Dump Stream Tree.
Record TSV logs and host version; compare match names, grouping kinds, child counts, depth, and observed errors.
Do not manipulate streams in this probe; record SHA-256 of captures; publish a separate result interpretation.

environment.plugin: ShapeLayerAE; source present; build status recorded separately

conclusion: User reported host failure in old AEX: GetNumStreamsInGroup only works on groups. Header precondition bug confirmed and source repaired; corrected AEX compiled but not host-retested. Native registry remains unproven.

user_reported_failure.error: After Effects error: internal verification failure, sorry! {GetNumStreamsInGroup only works on groups}
user_reported_failure.root_cause: AEGP LEAF=0 passed non-NONE predicate and was mistakenly treated as a group.
user_reported_failure.fix: Allow only NAMED_GROUP or INDEXED_GROUP; status: built, host retest pending.

build_receipt.verification: MSVC link succeeded; PiPL and exported EntryPointFunc confirmed; AE host load not tested

limitations: AEGP traversal reveals public representation only; it cannot prove hidden type-registration mechanism.
